nodes.description: Constant token symbol 'AVT' declared in contract ERC20.
Constant token name 'ArtVerse Token' declared in contract ERC20.
Constant token decimals set to 18.
Constant total supply 2100000000000 * 10**18, minted to deployer in constructor.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' by subtracting and adding to balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender key.
Arithmetic balance mutation inside transfer: balances[msg.sender] -= tokens and balances[to] += tokens.
Arithmetic balance mutation inside transferFrom: balances[from] -= tokens and balances[to] += tokens.
Arithmetic allowance mutation inside transferFrom: allowed[from][msg.sender] -= tokens.
Address parameter of balanceOf whose balance is read.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used in balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in balance and allowance arithmetic.
Owner address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.

edges.reason: Constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial supply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
msg.sender is used as the key into balances in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Constructor grants the entire supply to the caller identity msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] without any authorization check.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] relying on caller identity.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender key for the allowance check/debit.
balanceOf reads balances mapping.
tokenOwner is the lookup key in balanceOf.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
'to' is the destination key credited in transfer.
tokens parameter drives the amount moved in transfer.
transfer execution reaches the balance arithmetic block.
tokens parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction/addition.
The arithmetic result is written back into the balances mapping.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is the inner key written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.
from parameter is the debited key in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom execution reaches the balance arithmetic block.
tokens parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction/addition in transferFrom.
The arithmetic result is written back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom execution reaches the allowance arithmetic block.
tokens parameter is the operand of the allowance subtraction.
The allowance arithmetic result is written back into the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is decremented.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key read by allowance.
